sources.title: PAkshayV/dqn-SpaceInvadersNoFrameskip-v4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: DQN Agent playing SpaceInvadersNoFrameskip-v4 This is a trained model of a DQN agent playing SpaceInvadersNoFrameskip-v4 using the stable-baselines3 library and the RL Zoo. The RL Zoo is a training framework for Stable Baselines3 reinforcement learning agents, with hyperparameter optimization and pre-trained agents included.

sources.title: Training SpaceInvadersNoFrameskip with DQN | SERP AI
sources.snippet: To evaluate the model's performance, users typically run the enjoyment script provided with the RL Zoo framework: python -m rl_zoo3.enjoy --algo dqn --env SpaceInvadersNoFrameskip-v4 -f logs/. This command executes the trained policy in the environment, allowing for direct observation of the agent's gameplay.
